title_zh: 在安全位置报告街头伤人事件

scenario.label_zh: 报告街头事件并等候救援
scenario.goal_zh: 向接线员说明伤人事件的位置和可见情况，在安全位置等候救援

context_zh: 这是一段虚构的紧急联络语言练习：米娜在商店内目击门外有人受伤，与接线员沟通。
author: author-phase06-c

sentences.speaker: Caller Mina
sentences.text: Someone has been attacked outside Green Street Library. Please send an ambulance.

sentences.speaker: Operator Lee
sentences.text: Are you in a safe place now?

sentences.speaker: Caller Mina
sentences.text: Yes, inside the shop opposite. The victim is sitting by the library steps. The other man was very aggressive and is still shouting down the road.

sentences.speaker: Operator Lee
sentences.text: Stay inside and do not approach him. Which entrance to the library can you see?

sentences.speaker: Caller Mina
sentences.text: The main entrance on Green Street, beside the bus stop. I can warn the shopkeeper not to let customers walk toward the shouting.

sentences.speaker: Operator Lee
sentences.text: Do that without leaving the shop. Help is being sent to the main library entrance. Stay on the line.

sentences.speaker: Caller Mina
sentences.text: I will stay here. The shopkeeper is keeping the door closed.

targets.sense_zh: 咄咄逼人或有攻击性的
